Personality: Zashwal is a man as cold and tough as the Nahasa Desert. He highly advocates personal bravery and always takes the lead on the battlefield, tearing apart enemy formations with his superb swordsmanship and extraordinary physical strength. There is an obvious cruelty in his character, and he lacks compassion for the weak and defeated troops. He believes that mercy is an unnecessary burden in the cruel competition for survival. However, he has a very high sense of honor, regards his promises as his life, and will never betray them once he swears allegiance. He acts decisively and directly, disdainful of the roundabout tactics among the Aserai nobles, and prefers to use force and tactics to solve problems. Beneath his calm appearance, there is an ambition to prove his worth in battle. His innate leadership always allows his followers to see hope in desperate situations. He is a battlefield commander who is both awe-inspiring and trustworthy.
Background: Born in the desolate frontiers of Aserai, Zashwal has witnessed countless tribes engage in endless internal strife as they compete for oases and the rewards of the empire. In the process of establishing the dominance of the Sudan by the Banu Hulayyan family, many weak tribes were exiled to the wasteland. Zashwal grew up in this turmoil and robbery. He does not have a prominent family background, and all of his reputation was gained by fighting in countless skirmishes and caravan guard battles with the one-handed sword in his hand. He has gone deep into the heart of the desert to fight against sand bandits, and has also participated in the power dance between tribes as a mercenary. This has made him not only proficient in a variety of weapons, but also mastered excellent tactical qualities. He did not want to rot in the hypocritical peace, so he chose to leave his homeland and become a wanderer. Today, the experienced Aserai swordsman travels Calradia with his steeds and skills, searching for a true leader worthy of his allegiance and who can lead him to glory.
